title: FinanceBench holdout-60 replication pre-arm health-gate incident
event: Immediately after restarting CLIProxyAPI, the first gpt-5.4 warm-up probe returned HTTP 502 and the next four returned HTTP 200.
policy: Do not classify a pre-arm readiness failure as a benchmark replication. Use a readiness gate requiring five consecutive HTTP 200 responses per model before the first task; any infrastructure error after arm start still invalidates the full matrix.
